ChartGrid

US equities lost $3 trillion in a single session as a sharp sell-off in AI and chip stocks followed the midterms.

The Nasdaq 100 fell 6.3%, while the S&P 500 dropped 4.3%. Nvidia declined 9.0%, Microsoft 3.5% and Alphabet 2.3%. Data center infrastructure stocks also slid: IREN fell 16.0%, NBIS 15.1% and CIFR 14.6%.

The strongest post-midterm rally in 44 years proved brief. Bitcoin touched a low after falling 6.4%, and Ethereum dropped 7.9%.

The sell-off came as Democrats took control of Congress and expectations of tougher regulation grew. Rep. Yassamin Ansari proposed pausing advanced AI development and banning superintelligence. Senator Sanders has also called for a national moratorium on data centers. Wall Street is now factoring in a significant slowdown in AI infrastructure development.
